name: Warping Wise
tooltip:
Warping Wise
5 yd range
3.2 sec cast
Anglin' Score:  points.

Catch Rank: Guppy

Description:
A maliciously playful inhabitant of the void. Its deep attunement with the void allows it to warp between worlds in search of new fish to consume. Holding this fish has the chance to take Anglers along for the ride.

Special:

Whimsical Warp

Agitate the Warping Wise, teleporting you.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Voidstorm

Fishing Pools:
- Oceanic Vortex
- Viscous Void

Rates:
- This fish is mostly found in pools.

Discovery: Fishing
